answer_1.quote: We propose to automatically construct multimodal dialogue data... We also present RESEE, a generative conversational framework powered by real‑world visual experiences.

answer_2.quote: We employ automatic metrics to assess the model performance: (1) Fluency: perplexity (PPL) ... (2) Token‑based Relevance: BLEU and Rouge‑L ; Embedding‑based Relevance: ... (3) Diversity: Distinct‑1 (Dist‑1) and Distinct‑2 (Dist‑2).

answer_4.quote: We perform human evaluation over the generated responses. We consider three conventional criteria: fluency (Flue.), informativeness (Info.), and relevance (Relv.) ... We also consider Sensibleness and Specificity Average (SSA) metric.
answer_4.guideline: Human annotators rate responses on criteria such as fluency, informativeness, relevance, sensibleness, and specificity.
